text:
Priya: Quick recap from the customer pilot call: two asks that could derail our pilot timeline if we accept them now — auto rollback on critical eval failures, and on-prem quant validation kits.
Jon: We scoped pilot to notifications + manual rollback. Auto rollback needs canary logic, flapping protection, and SRE sign-off. That's non-trivial.
Ava: On-prem quant validation means shipping not just profiles but a tiny validation harness that runs inside the customer's infra. That ties into Private/Dedicated testing matrices.
Marco: Proposal: keep pilot limited. Deliverables: (1) per-prompt-set eval alerts with severity (info/warn/critical) and clear docs on absolute vs relative thresholds, (2) manual rollback UI + runbook + audit log entries, (3) batching & caching recs with sample sim outputs and config YAML, (4) hosted quant profiles + example artifacts, (5) exportable quant package + unsupported runner script (no Redwood validation).
Priya: Add explicit "deferred" language for auto-rollback & certified on-prem validation in release notes and sales FAQ so SEs don't overpromise.
Jon: I'll draft a short RFC for metric diff semantics and severity mapping.
Ava: I'll update the acceptance checklist in the gating PR and attach a sanitized sample prompt set for QA.
Marco: I'll assemble the export tarball (profile.pb, sample inputs, runner.sh) and label it "unsupported". Usage snippet for README:
```bash
# unsupported: run quant export runner
./runner.sh --profile /tmp/profile.pb --model /mnt/model --tests ./sample_prompts.json
```
deploy-bot: added card #optimize-pilot-5012 to release board
QA-bot: QA requirement: smoke eval run against sanitized prompt set before pilot acceptance
Priya: Ok, filing the gating PR now with the refined acceptance criteria. We'll escalate if a customer insists on auto-rollback.
